controller.primary_outcome: Unique-top exact answer accuracy on all 16 new synthetic test examples, relative to their paired direct answers.
controller.scope: One visible orange rectangular task frame. This is an image-derived region proposal, not learned general object grounding or optimal scale selection.
controller.selection: Retain the initial answer unless the follow-up has a unique non-uncertain answer and its top probability exceeds the initial top by at least .05. Probabilities are uncalibrated heuristics, not correctness guarantees.
controller.input_policy: Adaptive follow-up receives original overview plus full-frame crop. Repeat control receives the original overview again. Same final question/options; each image capped at512px. Control matches request count, not image-token budget.
controller.test_policy: Freeze controller, prompts and test generator before any new-test inference. Do not tune on test outcomes. Keep all outcomes.
